session_spawn.title: Start an agent on a task
session_spawn.description: Start an agent on a task. Creates a session record for the run, an initial log entry naming the provider (agent runner), model and reasoning effort, and a claim reserving the task for that session; committing that starts the agent, so a task a run still going holds refuses the whole request. A task a parked run is waiting on, or whose run a wake has asked for or started, starts nothing: that run gets the instruction, on its own provider, and the answer says so. With wait, returns how the run ended (its brief or final output, and its exit code when recorded) instead of the session id. Returns text in content.body. A wait timeout reports that the run is still running and does not kill it.

task.description: the task to hand to the agent, which the session claims; pass its id or registered name

provider.description: id or registered name of the provider (agent runner); it must use command-line transport

model.description: id or registered name of the model the run uses; optional, by default the model in the provider's using{model}

persona.description: the persona to carry, by id or name (default: the checkout's persona)

effort.description: the reasoning effort, where the model accepts such a setting

instruction.description: additional instructions beside the task body, which is the agent’s spec

wait.description: block until the run is over and return how it ended

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_stop.title: Stop a managed session
session_stop.description: Stop a session. A native transcript admits no further steps and reads stopped; an already admitted step may finish. A managed process receives SIGTERM and then SIGKILL if needed. Use session wait to see when it has ended. Returns text in content.body.

session.description: the session to stop; pass its id or registered name

session_wait.title: Wait for a session to end
session_wait.description: Wait for a session to end, then return its brief (or final output) and exit code when recorded, as text in content.body. A session still running when the timeout passes is reported as still running, never killed.

session.description: the session to wait on; pass its id or registered name

timeout.description: how long to wait: 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_peek.title: Read the end of a session
session_peek.description: Return the last entries of an agent work session as stored in the graph, plus where it stands: its status, or that it is parked and on what. Returns at most lines entries (40 by default, 256 maximum), with long entry bodies previewed, as text in content.body; never the provider’s own log file.

session.description: the session to read; pass its id or registered name

lines.description: how many entries to return, newest last (default 40)

spawn_complete.description: publish the final report on the task and deliver it to the spawning session after a managed run’s final log import

spawn_start.description: start the run a session asks for: a `using` written on an entry names the provider, the model and the effort

spawn_stop.description: kill the run a `stop` on the session running it names
